name: tetris
label: Tetris
css: .style-tetris { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #DFE7FF 0%, #f0f4ff 100%); min-height: 1080px; width: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 60px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Bangers', cursive; } .style-tetris::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -200px; right: -200px; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: var(--slide-primary); border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.08; z-index: 0; } .style-tetris .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary); line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 20px; position: relative; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -2px; } .style-tetris .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: #1C398E; line-height: 1.3; max-width: 900px; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-tetris .step { font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary); opacity: 0.12; position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 40px; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-tetris .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 60px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1C398E; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-tetris { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1C202B 0%, #2d3142 100%); } .slide-code.style-tetris .hook { color: #7107E7; } .slide-code.style-tetris .text { color: #DFE7FF; } .slide-code.style-tetris .step { color: #7107E7; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-tetris .brand { color: #DFE7FF; } .slide-code.style-tetris::before { background: var(--slide-primary); opacity: 0.06; } .slide-insight.style-tetris { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1C202B 0%, #16A34A 100%); } .slide-insight.style-tetris .hook { color: #16A34A; } .slide-insight.style-tetris .text { color: #DFE7FF; } .slide-insight.style-tetris .step { color: #16A34A; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-tetris .brand { color: #DFE7FF; } .slide-insight.style-tetris::before { background: #16A34A; opacity: 0.08; }
